provider.name: Interactive Brokers Australia Pty. Ltd.
provider.description: Australian subsidiary of global broker Interactive Brokers, ASIC-regulated (AFSL 453554) and a participant of ASX, ASX 24 and Cboe Australia, offering share, ETF, options, futures and forex trading across 90+ international markets.

offering.name: Interactive Brokers Australia
offering.description: IBKR Pro's Fixed-rate share trading plan for Australian investors: low per-trade commissions on ASX and US shares, a custodial (non-CHESS) holding model, and access to global markets beyond the ASX and US.

fees.label: Australian shares brokerage (Fixed plan)
fees.notes: IBKR publishes Fixed Australian stock commissions at 0.08% of trade value with a A$6 minimum per order, exclusive of GST. The calculator adds 10% GST. IBKR Tiered pricing and third-party fees are not included in this Fixed-plan estimate.

fees.label: Automated currency conversion
fees.notes: IBKR's automated currency conversion service rate, applied when a trade requires converting AUD to buy a foreign-currency security. A lower client-initiated standalone conversion rate of 0.002% (minimum US$2.00) is available if you convert currency manually ahead of time instead.
